remarks: Welcome to this beautifully drenched-in-light main level unit, offering 2 bedrooms plus a versatile den/office space. Step into the remodeled kitchen with its sleek new cabinets and brand-new stainless-steel appliances. The large living room is perfect for entertaining, while the spacious primary bedroom features his and her closets and ceiling fan. Enjoy the gorgeous hardwood floors throughout. One parking space and private back entrance. This unit also boasts all brand-new windows and a sparkling new full bathroom, making it move-in ready. Unbeatable location in the heart of downtown Stamford, you are just minutes away from trendy restaurants, schools, Jackie Robinson Park of Fame, I-95, beaches, boardwalk, brewery, a golf course, shopping, Stamford train station, Harbor Point, Crab Shell and so much more. Garage not included in rental. Available immediately. Small dog/cat will be considered. Excellent credit 680+
